column1: # tests/standins/12.tsv: what a person produces at phase 12's manual steps (see tests/standin.py).
# Each create-and-test step is the person's own gcloud pam entitlements create (the page's command, against the
# fake gcloud), so the step's check, which also describes the entitlement in Google, finds it afterwards.
# The variables those steps set get their fake values from the test itself. Names are written "$NAME", read from the
# sourced ~/.platform-env by the shell, because standin.py's ${NAME} expansion fails (its value() format string).

column3: p="$GE_CURRENT_PARENT"; case $p in organizations/*) f=--organization=${p#organizations/};; *) f=--folder=${p#folders/};; esac; gcloud pam entitlements create ent-project-move-src $f --location=global --entitlement-file="$PLATFORM_REPO_DIR"/pam/entitlements/ent-project-move-src.json --billing-project="$CICD_PROJECT"
